issues.description: The UML in the problem statement defines the Lecture attributes as private (encapsulated) and the reference solution implements them as private, but the template file pre-declares some attributes as public (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents). This inconsistency may confuse students about whether to declare attributes private and implement getters/setters (the task asks for getters/setters) or to keep public fields, and it undermines the encapsulation lesson.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Lecture class consistent with the UML and solution by declaring all lecture attributes as private (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) and removing the pre-declared public fields. Leave TODOs for students to implement the constructor, getters and setters. Alternatively, if public fields were intentional, update the problem statement/UML to reflect public attributes and adjust the tasks accordingly.
